verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent monitoring covers conversation replay, LLM call comparison, traces, cost, token, tool-call dashboards, and capture of prompts and outputs. Nothing in the evidence documents scoring outputs with LLM-as-a-judge or any configurable evaluators. Scoring outputs is a fair question for an AI observability product, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.
